value.rationale: The per-prescribed-image retraction fibre law and total-vertex image-rank polynomial supply a complete natural invariant of finite tree-compatibility monoids that is invisible in prior unweighted wreath-product idempotent totals. Gap-free possible ranks with sharp smallest/next-smallest/largest-proper coefficients distinguish the ultrametric geometry of retraction images. This is a motivated all-parameter classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
